notes.title: "Alina of the Arena" is hitting on Console on November 23, 2023
notes.content:
Hi All,

DANGEN Entertainment and PINIX Games are excited to announce the official release date for "Alina of the Arena," on consoles, set to debut on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Xbox digital stores on November 23, 2023. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40751544/67e22f66fdbf818bac8e4c87f67738aadf2942a3.png[/img]

Winner of multiple awards in the indie space and a successful PC launch in 2022, "Alina of the Arena" transports players to a striking pixelated world of relentless arena combat where survival is the ultimate challenge. As Alina, a valiant female gladiator, players must entertain a bloodthirsty crowd, round by round, as they climb up the ranks and try to emerge victorious.

Fight for glory! "Alina of the Arena" is hitting consoles on November 23, 2023.

notes.title: Upcoming Price Increase
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
With the final boss update released, we have hit all Early Access goals for Alina of the Arena, which means it's finally time to leave Early Access! As such, we're announcing in advance that [b]Alina of the Arena will be raised to full price on August 10[/b].

notes.title: The last week for EA launch now, About EA you should to know.
notes.content:
➡️  Why Early Access? 
✅  “Alina of the Arena is a deckbuilding game, and one of the hardest things with deckbuilding games is balancing the cards. Early Access will help us test the cards, tweak their values, and allow us to work with everyone to make this game the best it could be.”

➡️  Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
✅  “We are aiming for around 2-4 months to finetune Alina. Obviously if all goes well we'd launch sooner rather than later, but even if things don't go well, we're confident that it'll be ready for launch in 6 months at most.”

➡️  How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
✅  “The final game will include 3 areas, each with 2 Champions (bosses) you can challenge. The Early Access version will launch with 1 Champion per area, while the rest will be added over the Early Access period.
Enemies, cards, items, and equipment will also be added and tweaked during this period.”

➡️  What is the current state of the Early Access version?
✅  “The Early Access version is mostly feature complete, aside from the 3 Champions mentioned above. Other than that, feel free to check the "About this Game" section for an up-to-date description of what's available!”

➡️  Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
✅  “Yes, we want to thank players who are willing to support us during the game's development, so Alina of the Arena will be available at a discount during Early Access. This price will be gradually raised as development reaches completion.”

➡️  How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
✅  “We would love you to come hang out on our Discord and Steam community forum! Any feedback, bug reports, or general chit-chat are welcome here.

- Discord: https://discord.gg/EF3HTqW
- Steam Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1668690/discussions/”

notes.title: 《Alina of the Arena》Open Playtest Begins August 28!
notes.content:
Hi, 《Alina of the Arena》will open playtest begins!

[h3]TIME[/h3]
The open playtest will begin on [b]August 28[/b] and end on [b]August 30.[/b]

[h3]HOW TO JOIN IT[/h3]
Go to the Steam store page and click 'Request Access'.
We will random a part of players that join the playtest on opening time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40751544/ba8d9f7b4341c7dcc8e35d49822db137a88bbd85.png[/img]
